name: facepuppet
description: Webcam-driven 2.5D photo face puppet. Standalone single-file app: index.html. Advanced Canvas-2D demo: puppet.html.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js src/puppet/*.js tools/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node tools/build.mjs --check && node tools/check-index.mjs
scripts.test: node tools/build.mjs --check && node tools/check-index.mjs && node tools/verify.mjs && node tools/harness.mjs && node tools/harness-index.mjs
